text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER - SEV: high - region us-west1 GPU pool failing to scale. Autoscaler attempts returning quota errors. Affected: inference-worker pools (gpu-pool-prod-uw1). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota

Inez (oncall): ack, pulling autoscaler + cloud logs now. marking P1.

Ash (sre): seeing repeated GCP errors when creating node groups: `403 Quota exceeded for project X: GPU_TOTAL_QUOTA`
Ash (sre): autoscaler log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z autoscaler: scale_up request for gpu-pool-prod-uw1 -> create 8 nodes
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z compute.googleapis.com: ERROR 403: Quota exceeded for project X.
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z autoscaler: will retry, backoff
2026-03-15T09:14:11Z autoscaler: failed to provision 8 nodes: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED
```

Inez (oncall): thanks. estimate: queue growing on inference-api-uw1. can someone pull metrics for queue length and latency?

Lucy (support): looking at dashboards now - queues for uw1 ingestion up ~1.2k requests (5m avg). 95th token latency from 3.2s -> 9.6s. Error rate for customer-bound calls in region up to 5.8%. Customers on dedicated plans in us-west1 flagged.

Alex (services): routing config allows region failover to us-west2 for most hosts. can toggle traffic for non-enterprise customers, but enterprise/dedicated pins may need manual reroute.

Maya (scale-eng): can spin up a temporary spare pool in us-west2 with mixed GPU types (T4 fallback) and put autoscaling target lower to keep latency acceptable. prepping terraform patch now. ETA ~14m if quota available in west2.

Inez (oncall): action list: 1) Ash confirm GCP quota is global (project) or regional. 2) Maya attempt west2 fallback. 3) Alex start selective routing (non-dedicated). 4) Lucy prepare customer-impact note. 5) Ron coordinate comms.

Ash (sre): quick check: GCP returned region-specific error but IAM quota is per project per region in this case. raising quota request will take hours. immediate path: failover or evict lower-priority workloads.

Maya (scale-eng): starting small pool in us-west2 (t4) with reduced batch sizes. applying config: 
```yaml
module "gpu_pool_spare" {
  instance_type = "t4"
  min_size = 2
  max_size = 8
  labels = { fallback = "true" }
}
```
Maya (scale-eng): deploying now -> `terraform apply` underway.

Alex (services): toggling routing for 70% of free-tier and standard customers to us-west2. leaving enterprise/dedicated pinned to uw1. will post traffic switch command when done.

deploy-bot: deploy started by Maya (scale-eng) for terraform/gpu_pool_spare. CI job 9876 triggered.

Inez (oncall): Ash - can we kill any low-priority GPU jobs in uw1? show the eviction command?

Ash (sre): yes. majority of batch-training jobs are marked low-priority. evict command: `kubectl -n ml delete pod -l priority=low --grace-period=30`
Ash (sre): going to evict 6 pods (should free ~4 GPUs).

Ash (sre): evicted pods, freed 4 GPUs - autoscaler attempted scale up again and still got quota refusal. so not enough.

Lucy (support): customer impact summary draft: "We are seeing elevated latency and request queuing for customers with inference traffic routed to us-west1. Workarounds: many non-dedicated requests are being routed to us-west2; dedicated/pinned workloads in us-west1 may experience degraded throughput until quota is resolved or manual migration completed." Will circulate draft to Ron.

Ron (pm): okay. prioritize message to enterprise contacts after we confirm dedicated fallback options. also let's capture timelines and which customer ids affected. Lucy, attach list of customer org ids.

Maya (scale-eng): terraform completed, preflight passed, pool in us-west2 reporting healthy nodes (2/2). autoscaler in west2 healthy. spinning up a few workers.

Alex (services): started routing change: switching 70% of non-pinned traffic -> us-west2. Command: `trafficctl route set --from=uw1 --to=uw2 --pct=70`

deploy-bot: trafficctl job 4421 completed successfully.

Inez (oncall): monitoring metrics. queue length uw1 falling slowly (-30% in 10m) as traffic shifts. 95th latency for non-pinned now ~4.1s.

Lucy (support): compiling affected customer list: 6 enterprise customers pinned to uw1 showing degradation. 42 standard customers moved to uw2 automatically. will prepare targeted emails for the 6.

Ash (sre): new problem: we hit a soft limit on vCPU quota in us-west2 for the T4s; autoscaler in west2 is constrained but can still handle current shift with lower parallelism. requesting emergency soft-quota bump with cloud support (submitted). Ticket: GCP-2026-9982.

Inez (oncall): mitigation update: live failover + eviction freed enough headroom to avoid full outage. still P1 due to enterprise customer impact and unknown time for quota bump.

Ron (pm): approved customer note for enterprise contacts. Lucy please send the first notice: brief summary, what we're doing, ETA unknown for quota fix but we have a fallback in place. include recommended action: consider temporary routing to other regions for large job runs.

Lucy (support): sent emails to enterprise contacts, posted status on status.redwood.com. :mailbox_with_mail:

Ash (sre): as precaution, enabling autoscaler fallback to use mixed-instance pools (if GCP quota prevents specific GPU SKU), config snippet: 
```json
{"autoscaler": {"use_mixed_instances": true, "preferred_skus": ["a100","t4"]}}
```

Maya (scale-eng): switched autoscaler config to allow mixed SKUs in uw1 pool (so it can accept t4 if a100 unavailable). applying now.

Inez (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline for 30m to handle another critical page. Maya will be taking over incident lead. If anything spikes, please escalate to oncall-maya or @pager.ash

Maya (scale-eng): taking over. I have the current checklist and will keep updates here. We're tracking: 1) quota ticket progress, 2) autoscaler mixed-sku behavior, 3) progress migrating pinned customers if needed.

incident-bot: incident updated - status: mitigation in progress; severity: P1; incident lead: Maya (scale-eng). Pager routing updated.

Inez (oncall): thanks all — leaving notes in the runbook and handoff channel.

Maya (scale-eng): next update in 20m or earlier if quota ticket advances or if any region metrics degrade. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
